chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
chung.Description:
This course aims to introduce students to understand the basic of technical analysis and how to apply it to investment.

After the class, students have ability to use technical analysis to evaluate and predict the future price movement of financial assets, such as stocks, currencies, commodities, by analyzing historical price chart and trading volumes instead of focusing on the intrinsic value of an asset.

The course includes the following main topics: Charts and Parttens, Indicators, Candlestick Analysis, Market trends, Risk management.

clo: Analyze the foundations of technical analysis
Understand the main principles of technical analysis
Understand the principles of chart analysis with proficient skills in identifying chart patterns, market trends, support and resistance levels
Proficient in drawing and interpreting stock market focasting trendlines with Fibonacci sequences, Dow Theory and other theories
Proficient in using moving averages, RSI, MACD, and other key technical indicators in analyzing price movements and trading signals
Formulate trading strategies and evaluate the risks and rewards based on technical analysis
Make appropriate decisions by considering technical analysis, fundamental analysis, and other forms of market analysis
